anchorMeaning: Original render origin [19,41] mapped by originalScale=8 and originalOffset=[32,40]; derived cap calibration, not an anatomical joint guarantee.
method: One direction scale: median(original body heights * 8) / median(own body heights). Each resampled frame is translated by integer pixels to match the corresponding original cap top and upper-band X centroid. Original head bob and lateral motion are retained; feet are not locked.
